## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes (registry, manifest, previews) and `registry.json` is committed
- [ ] `pnpm smoke` and `pnpm health` pass (starter app install + shadcn Registry Health mirror)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm check:content` pass
- [ ] New or changed components have a demo in `demos/<name>/` registered in `demos/index.ts`
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this changes anything users install
- [ ] No breaking change to item names, `/r/{name}.json` or `/ui-preview` paths or CSS token names (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
